generation_brief: Original transparent 4 by 4 fantasy Minecraft inventory sprite atlas. Eight escalating magic book tiers: brown sapphire, copper green, silver blue crescent, gold purple, black red flame, white cyan halo, obsidian violet star, and celestial gold iridescent super-tier. Universal navy cyan grimoire, blue mana potion, violet greater potion, silver blue mana apple, ivory teal amnesia tome. Three white arcane rune overlays. Crisp richly detailed pixel art; no letters, numbers, labels or borrowed game assets.
export: Equal 4x4 tiles, trim transparent bounding box, nearest-neighbor resize to a maximum 60 pixels, center on 64x64 transparent canvas. Tile14 is normalized to a 15 pixel corner badge; no repainting.
book_tint: Untinted original cover at layer0; layer1 school rune uses custom_model_data.colors[0].
